feed.title: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugins — Curated List · Awesome DSH Plugin

entry.title: daetz-coder/dsh-multi-chat
entry.summary: A multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.

entry.title: yoli-mi/dsh-client-ui-custom
entry.summary: Web theming (wallpaper, glass, accent, presets), keyboard shortcuts, usage stats, a plugin marketplace, a floating history strip, and user-message Markdown rendering.

entry.title: sjh9714/dsh-what-changed
entry.summary: Session-wide file change review. Lists every file the agent wrote this session with its hunks, counts refused writes separately from changes, and folds from a session projection.

entry.title: chenproton/dsh-history
entry.summary: Browse every message you sent in the current session: full-history listing with newest-first sort, text filter, one-click copy, and click-to-jump that auto-loads earlier history when the target is not yet loaded.

entry.title: phelpsyacht/dshmath-manim
entry.summary: Manim CE based math animation plugin: 6 built-in templates (function/derivative/integral/geometry/polar/3D surface) plus a zero-code skill pack (math-animation / manim-codegen) - natural language to animated math videos, with AST static security validation.

entry.title: moon09300731/dsh-vision-tools
entry.summary: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a `vision_understand` tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.

entry.title: moon09300731/dsh-approval-gate
entry.summary: Risk-gated approval automation: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe).

entry.title: gwrsfsfeefdsfs/dsh-skill-curator
entry.summary: Meta-skill for DSH skill experience feedback and knowledge accumulation: feeds fixes back into skills and records a searchable knowledge base (keyword + local bge semantic retrieval, 7-point write-back checklist, anti-bloat archiving), with self-validation and event-hook tools.

entry.title: beancookie/dsh-plugin-nintendo
entry.summary: NES emulator built on jsnes: play in a popup window with a hotkey toggle, agents can load ROMs via the `nes_play` tool, with save/load and screenshots.

entry.title: Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin
entry.summary: Composer microphone: click for continuous monitoring or hold to talk; browser speech recognition types words into the composer as you speak, while replies are read aloud as they stream via host Edge TTS (sentence-split), pausing recognition while reading to avoid echo, click to stop.

entry.title: lak321/dsh-filetree
entry.summary: Project file browser: per-session file tabs, a directory tree, and a VSCode-style editor (C syntax highlighting, line numbers, auto-indent, status bar) that follows the current workspace.

entry.title: Laplace-bit/dsh-smooth-stream
entry.summary: Silky streaming reveal for the Web UI: text appears at the model's arrival rate, new lines glide in, no flicker; follow stays with the user and `prefers-reduced-motion` is respected.

entry.title: Liu-ZA-81/dsh-theme-firefly
entry.summary: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme: wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.

entry.title: xiaoyanzi191/dsh-premium-themes
entry.summary: 8 curated color schemes plus custom palette import (name + scheme + seed colors derive a full token map), a Palette row in General settings, hot-plug install.

entry.title: ink5897/dsh-theme-kit
entry.summary: 32 preset themes across three palettes (Morandi, Macaron, Chinese traditional), animated and static wallpapers, paper textures, per-zone opacity and text depth, plus a keyboard desktop pet.

entry.title: futongxu9-maker/dsh-msgrail
entry.summary: Message-index rail at the conversation's right edge: one brand-colored dot per user message, hover to preview, click to jump, auto-loads older history; pure plugin with no host patching.

entry.title: edfrey0044/dsh-unarchive
entry.summary: Restore archived sessions: a /unarchive command and an unarchive_session tool that remove sessions from the archive set so they reappear in the workspace at their original position (archiving never deletes data).

entry.title: bowenliang123/dsh-context
entry.summary: Context insight panel: see what the model's context window is made of and how it evolves — composition vs. window size, per-request history, compression/injection events, and per-message token stats.

entry.title: Breeze136/kb-rag
entry.summary: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 8 tools (PDF/folder/Zotero ingest, hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, scope/strict modes, dedup/clear/stats), all-local bge embeddings + single-file SQLite, measured 242-doc/86s ingest and sub-second hot queries on 20k chunks.

entry.title: futongxu9-maker/dsh-shared-memory
entry.summary: Cross-conversation shared memory: MEMORY.md + USER.md injected into every session's system prompt, with a memory tool and a GUI panel (Hermes-style).

entry.title: Anlushu/hkinsure
entry.summary: Hong Kong insurance data MCP: 260+ real products, 17 insurers, dividend fulfillment rates. Query/compare/calculate for any AI tool (Hermes / dsh / Claude Code).

entry.title: gongyijie85/dsh-repo-setup
entry.summary: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db hints and recommends skill plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files (claude-code-setup counterpart).

entry.title: gloryxpnv/dsh-tool-vision
entry.summary: Local-first vision for the text-only DeepSeek Harness: a local VLM (LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM) produces structured JSON evidence (OCR / layout / semantics) at zero API cost, with image data never leaving the machine.

entry.title: lak321/dsh-voice-chat
entry.summary: Voice chat: 🎤 speech input (Web Speech, live editable interim results) plus 🔊 automatic/manual read-aloud replies (TTS), with voice, speed, pitch and recognition-language settings (Mandarin/Cantonese, etc.); fully client-side with zero keys, and Markdown is stripped before reading.

entry.title: lak321/dsh-screen-agent
entry.summary: Desktop and web automation: 📸 multi-screen screenshots, 🔍 Windows OCR (text + pixel coordinates), 🖱️ mouse click/drag, ⌨️ Chinese typing/keys, and 🪟 window activation, with battle-tested drawing in Paint (mouse acceleration compensation, canvas positioning, Bézier curves).

entry.title: futongxu9-maker/dsh-path-reveal
entry.summary: Click any absolute Windows path in DSH messages to reveal it in Explorer (select the file or open the folder).

entry.title: yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-anti-bot-http
entry.summary: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.

entry.title: yangyunsong023/dsh-sxs-news-collector
entry.summary: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.

entry.title: cdxiaodong/dsh-llm-inspector
entry.summary: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.

entry.title: siweina/dsh-novel-writer
entry.summary: Novel writing assistant: chapter library, sentence-pattern analysis (9 categories / emotion curve / style fingerprint), style check, plot tracking, batch import and continuation writing, with per-tool Web UI toggles.
